title.en: A cryptography-inspired search finds a hidden pulsar
title.zh: 借来密码学算法，在旧数据中找到脉冲星

summary.en: A November19 study found an isolated gamma-ray pulsar in fifteen years of Fermi data with about ten CPU hours. Its dramatic case comparison opens a useful search frontier, with background and binary-system limits still clear.
summary.zh: 11月19日研究用约十个CPU小时，在费米望远镜十五年数据中找到孤立伽马射线脉冲星。个案计算优势带来新可能，背景噪声与双星搜索仍有边界。

title.en: COP31 closes with a political gap and a separate action ledger
title.zh: COP31闭幕：谈判缺口与另一份行动账本

summary.en: Simon Stiell’s November22 closing assessment reports disagreement over presidency-led decisions alongside other negotiating and voluntary progress. Grid deployment, investment plans and draft texts carry different kinds of evidence.
summary.zh: 西蒙·斯蒂尔11月22日闭幕讲话称主席国主导决定未能达成一致，同时指出其他谈判与自愿行动进展。电网建设、投资计划和草案体现不同层次的证据。
